item.title: Gayle King renews contract with CBS News amid leadership changes
item.description: (ABC36 NEWS NOW) – Veteran broadcaster Gayle King is staying with CBS News. A spokesperson confirmed that King has renewed her contract with the network. item.title: “Swiftie” officially added to Dictionary.com as Taylor Swift fan term
item.description: (ABC36 NEWS NOW) – The term “Swiftie” now has official dictionary recognition. Dictionary.com has added the word to its online dictionary, defining it as “a fan of the music of” Taylor Swift. Swift trademarked the term back in 2017 and has used it on merchandise connected to her brand. Dictionary.com regularly adds new words to reflect how the English language...

item.title: 45,000 HALO Magic Sleepsuits recalled over infant choking hazard
